description: TypeScript SDK monorepo for Frontal services, with a unified client, service packages, Zod schemas, and React hooks.
rules: Use @frontal-labs/sdk for the unified Frontal client or import a service package directly.
The unified client entry is packages/sdk; service implementations live in packages/<service>.
Use the committed contracts/sdk-endpoints.json and OpenAPI snapshots as the source of truth for endpoint methods and paths.
Use Zod v4 schemas for payload validation; derive caller inputs with z.input and outputs with z.infer.
Use Bun for workspace scripts and Turborepo for package tasks.
